name: RingPad
notes: RingPad owns its release recipe (ringpad-v...-padmint.json). Apple Silicon Mac builds a personal unsigned iPhone/iPad IPA from the player's own Sonic Adventure PAL v1.003 GDI; the build checks every track's hash first.

steps: Open RingPad and tap Import Game, then choose the folder that holds your Sonic Adventure PAL v1.003 .gdi and its three tracks. RingPad checks every track before installing it.
Tap ••• for save states, graphics, touch controls and controller settings. Dreamcast Original is the default picture.
For updates, install over the existing app with the same signing setup to keep your disc, saves and settings. Export your VMU save from ••• ▸ Game Files before changing how you install.
